title: Rudolfo Alberto Hamburger - British Consulate Enquiry Re

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section I, Special Branch.
File No. 7796
REPORT
Date May 3rd, 1940.
Subject Rudolfo Alberto Hamburger - British Consulate enquiry re.
Made by D. S. I. Hide. Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

With reference to the attached letter from the
British Consulate General regarding Rudolfo Alberto
Hamburger, I have to report that the only reference to
this individual on Police files is to the effect that he
arrived from the south by the s/s Kwaiseng on June 18th,
1939, and departed for Hongkong by the s/s Yusang on
March 6th 1940.

Mr. C.H. Stableford, Deputy Commissioner of
Public Works, states that Hamburger, a German by birth,
was employed as an architect in the Public Works
Department from 1930 to 1935. His services were
terminated on the reduction of staff at the expiry of his
long leave. He was recommended by Dr. H. Woidt, former
commercial manager of the A.E.G. China Electric Co., 267
Kiangse Road.

Shortly after Mr. Stableford returned from long
leave in November 1939, he was visited by Hamburger who
stated that he was employed by a Swiss firm and had just
arrived in Shanghai prior to proceeding to Chungking. He
recently wrote to Mr. Stableford from Chungking to the
effect that he was experiencing difficulty regarding his
passport and requesting him to communicate with the
British Consulate on his behalf.

Before Mr. Stableford had time to comply with
this request he received a telephone call from the
British Consulate requesting information regarding
Hamburger. He has since replied by letter.

（左侧手写批注：Copy sent. 4/5.）
（左下角手写批注：5/40）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
第一科，特别股。
档案编号 7796
报告
日期：1940年5月3日。
事由：鲁道夫·阿尔贝托·汉伯格（Rudolfo Alberto Hamburger）——英国领事馆查询事宜。
呈报人：警探长 D. S. I. Hide。转呈人：督察 D. I. Crawford。

兹就附上的英国总领事馆关于鲁道夫·阿尔贝托·汉伯格的来信，本人谨报告如下：警方档案中对该人的唯一记录显示，他于1939年6月18日乘“葵盛”轮（s/s Kwaiseng）从南方抵沪，并于1940年3月6日乘“裕生”轮（s/s Yusang）离沪前往香港。

工务局副总办 C.H. Stableford 先生称，汉伯格系德裔，1930年至1935年间受雇于工务局担任建筑师。在其长假期满时，因裁员而终止了其服务。他是由江西路267号德国通用电气中国公司（A.E.G. China Electric Co.）前商务经理 H. Woidt 博士推荐的。

1939年11月，Stableford 先生休完长假返岗后不久，汉伯格曾前来拜访，声称自己受雇于一家瑞士公司，在前往重庆之前刚刚抵达上海。他最近从重庆致信 Stableford 先生，称其在护照方面遇到困难，并请求 Stableford 先生代表他与英国领事馆联系。

Stableford 先生尚未及照此请求办理，便接到英国领事馆的电话，询问有关汉伯格的情况。此后，他已通过信函回复。

（左侧手写批注：副本已发送。5月4日。）
（左下角手写批注：1940年5月）

British Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
April 29th 1940.
9996

Confidential

Dear Mr. Yorke,

I should be grateful for any information
you have on file regarding Rudolfo Alberto
Hamburger, a naturalised Hondurian.

He gave his address as 220 West End Gardens
but he is at present in Chungking.

His occupation is given as architect,
engineer, and he quotes Mr. Stableford, Deputy
Commissioner, Public Works Department, Shanghai
Municipal Council.

Yours sincerely,

R.W. Yorke, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。
1940年4月29日。
9996

机密

约克先生台鉴：

如贵处档案中有关于归化洪都拉斯籍人士鲁道夫·阿尔贝托·汉伯格的任何信息，本人将不胜感激。

他提供的地址为西端花园220号，但他目前身在重庆。

其职业登记为建筑师、工程师，他提及的推荐人为上海公共租界工部局工务局副总办 Stableford 先生。

此致
敬礼，

R.W. Yorke 先生，
副督察，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
